summary: Full regression test of cookie-only session migration (frontend httpOnly cookie auth, removal of localStorage/Authorization-header). Tested via real Playwright/Chromium against the public HTTPS preview URL and backend pytest against the same URL. All scenarios in the review request passed.
critical_code_review_comments: api.ts / AuthContext.tsx / views.py changes reviewed - clean implementation. authEpoch race-guard correctly replaces the old localStorage-comparison guard. _clear_auth_cookies correctly mirrors _set_auth_cookies attributes.
No remaining references to kdps_access/kdps_refresh found - migration is complete.

Note for future reference: backend/tests/conftest.py has a safety guard that skips live-API test suites against non-localhost URLs unless KDPS_TEST_ALLOW_REMOTE=1 is set (since this is a shared/remote deployment with non-deletable append-only records) - this is intentional and correct behavior, not a bug.
seed_data_creation: One TEST-like partner settlement payment of Rs.100 (cash) was recorded on BANKA store via accounts1 during the mutation regression check on /money/partner-dues - visible as voucher 26-27/HO/PSET/15. Not prefixed TEST_ since this endpoint doesn't support deletion (append-only ledger, by design) - flagging for awareness, not a cleanup action needed since it's a legitimate real payment record test data pattern already used by prior sessions (saw pre-existing 'PLAYWRIGHT-TEST'/'TEST-REF-1' entries in the same ledger).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cookie-only session migration verified end-to-end: (1) login sets httpOnly access_token/refresh_token cookies with Secure+SameSite=None, localStorage stays completely empty of token keys; (2) session survives full page reload; (3) logout clears both cookies (confirmed via page.context.cookies(), only cf_clearance/__cf_bm remain) and server-side session truly ends (direct nav to '/' post-logout bounces to /login, confirmed via a fresh cookie-less GET returning 401); (4) 3-role regression (owner/accounts1/deo.manager) all show correct role-specific dashboards + RBAC sidebar (deo.manager correctly got a clean 'No access' page for /setup/stores, not a crash); (5) Partner Dues mutation (Record Payment, +Rs.100) succeeded via cookie-only auth with zero Authorization headers on any request during the whole session; (6) fresh cookie-less browser context hitting '/' redirects cleanly to /login with no infinite retry loop, only expected one-time 401/400 console noise from the bootstrap auth check; (7) backend pytest confirmed BOTH the JSON-body token response on login (for curl/Postman) and Authorization:Bearer header-based auth (CookieOrHeaderJWTAuthentication) still work fully end-to-end, unaffected by the frontend-only migration. No bugs found.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no bug found, this was a feature-migration regression test and it fully passed.
